evidence: Arithmetic on one lake model's saved columns: biosphere/ecology/lake.py (the final model, wind-driven deep mixing) run by lake_anoxia, the lake kinds study and the sea oxygen study, whose daily columns and step-by-step series the tracer reads without running the model. Methane is a tracer of its own, made by lake_anoxia's rule in anoxic water and on every floor, moved by the model's own mixing and diffusivity, bubbled by lake_anoxia's porewater balance and rising bubble, oxidised by Michaelis-Menten methanotrophs whose rates are Earth's measured ranges carried to engineered communities as design variables, its oxygen accounted against the model's reoxidation of its debt, and exchanged with the air at the model's own transfer velocity. The transport is checked against the model's own age and debt, the kinetics against an analytic profile, the bubbles against lake_anoxia's physics and Lake Soppen. The anaerobic pathways are held to their acceptors' supply from the land's erosion and Earth's rates. No lunar lake or sea has been measured; the air's steady methane is lake_anoxia's arithmetic on the domain synthesis's ledger.
reading_rule: Fluxes in mol per m2 of lake (or sea) surface a year unless named per m2 of floor; Tg of CH4 a year Moon-wide; t a year per km2 for the meromictic lakes. Lanes: earth is Earth's lake community at Earth's central rates (biology.EARTH), designed and poor the ends of Earth's ranges a design reaches for or must allow, none no methanotrophs (its traced transient; all it makes would leave once its store filled), share/low and share/high the methane share's 0.3 and 0.8, kinetics/* one parameter at an end of its range, overturn/<cells per mL>/<growth per day> the stock the water keeps and the response time, aom/* the anaerobic pathways at their acceptors' supply. emitted is diffusive and bubbles together; at_overturns within an overturn's window (its first full mixing to thirty days past its last); overturns_summed sums a lane's overturns. passes give each pass's stores and, where recorded, its emission and methane made. Rungs are the kinds' ladder and giants by each lake's deepest point; kinds.moon_tg_yr splits the lakes between the 100 m and 352 m rungs at the lake kinds census's ventilated depth, and kinds.ventilation gives the split at either rung and by the nearest rung; kinds.giants reads each giant's deep oxygen. Seas by basin weight each basin by what its columns stand for, its water by local depth from its own shelf shares: the 3 m pan to 5 m, the 10 m pan to 30 m, the lakes' ladder rungs at the basin's band to 200 m (upper-leaning; with_shelves_deep_columns_beyond_30m gives the deep columns there instead) and the deep column beyond; aom/all/central is every anaerobic pathway at the high-erosion end (setting.anaerobic_sets); seas.directions carries the seas' study's reading of its unsettled columns and what it makes of their methane. Shih and Bouffard's figures add the change the form makes per m2 where it was run. air gives lake_anoxia's air() for lakes and seas together: lakes_uncut is the waters at these fluxes with every other source cut 90%, and room_under_held_tg_yr the Tg a year the waters could add before the held methane is passed (negative, the removal that holds it); lakes_and_seas_share carries the methane share's 0.3, 0.5 and 0.8 as low, central and high.

anaerobic_sets.aom/all/central: every pathway at the high-erosion end: the floors' iron and manganese at the earliest erosion (8.3 Gt a year, the soil loss the phosphorus particles imply) with highland soils, nitrate at Lake Constance's geometric-mean actual rate, sulphate at its renewal
anaerobic_sets.aom/all/high: every pathway at the high-erosion end with mare soils and nitrate at Lake Constance's highest actual rate
anaerobic_sets.aom/iron/latest_highland: the floors' iron and manganese at the latest erosion, 0.71 Gt a year (the conservation study's 10 m a million years), highland soils
anaerobic_sets.aom/iron/earliest_highland: the floors' iron and manganese at the earliest erosion, highland soils
anaerobic_sets.aom/iron/earliest_mare: the floors' iron and manganese at the earliest erosion, mare soils
anaerobic_sets.aom/nitrate/low: nitrate and nitrite at Lake Constance's lowest actual rate
anaerobic_sets.aom/nitrate/high: nitrate and nitrite at its highest actual rate
anaerobic_sets.aom/sulphate: sulphate at 1.4 uM, renewed by the throughflow
